decisions.D1: gh api write = effective method is not GET: explicit -X/--method value (also -XPOST, --method=POST; case-insensitive) when given, else POST when any of -f/--raw-field/-F/--field/--input is present, else GET — gh's own documented default. `--method GET … -f k=v` on an /issues path is a GET with query parameters and is forwarded (a read).
decisions.D2: issue verb match mirrors isPrMergeInvocation: drop tokens starting with '-', find `issue`, refuse when any later positional is one of comment|create|edit|close|reopen|delete|pin|unpin|transfer|lock|unlock|develop (covers `gh issue --repo o/r comment 5`). Accepted over-refusal: a flag value equal to a verb (`gh issue list --search close`), a GitHub-issue read Legion never does.
decisions.D3: /issues path match: with `api` positional, any positional matching /\/issues(?:[/?]|$)/ and D1 non-GET. Covers repos/o/r/issues (create), …/issues/5, …/issues/5/comments, …/issues/comments/123, …/issues/5/labels, full URLs; not …/pulls/…, not graphql. Accepted over-refusals: (a) raw-API edit/delete of a PR conversation comment (…/issues/comments/<id>) — use `gh pr comment --edit-last`; (b) a non-GET call whose flag value contains /issues/ — the imprecision isPrMergeInvocation already accepts for /merge.
decisions.D4: Message: `Legion issues live on Dispatch; use dispatch_message or dispatch_comment on <key>` with <key> = env.LEGION_ISSUE when set and non-empty, else the words `the Dispatch issue`. CliError, exit 1, stderr via runCli.
decisions.D5: One `if` in cmdGh after the isPrMergeInvocation check, before redeemGitHubToken — no grant read, no daemon call. Predicate, verb set, body-flag list are module-private in index.ts beside isPrMergeInvocation; no new file.
decisions.D6: Footer stays on the Dispatch message (spec). skills/legion-worker/SKILL.md lines 168-170 (`this footer is only for GitHub PR artifacts`) amended to name the retro's Dispatch message as the one Dispatch carrier — adjacent fix the change causes, not in the spec's Design table.
decisions.D7: Frontmatter example: related_issues gets "LEGION-123" (the Dispatch issue) and "owner/repo#456" (the pull request), the shape recent docs/solutions entries use (e.g. docs/solutions/daemon/a-failed-list-panes-proves-nothing-about-the-pane.md lines 18-20).
decisions.D8: Acceptance greps forbid `gh issue`, `gh -- issue`, `issue comment <` in skills/ + roles/ and `issue comment` in skills/legion-*/. The new legion-worker refusal sentence names verbs as the `issue` subcommand's comment, create, … and never spells `gh issue` or `issue comment`; root AGENTS.md uses the same phrasing. The dispatch skill's `floating issue comment` stays.
decisions.D9: Deployment: <state_dir>/bin/legion re-execs bun <daemon checkout>/packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts per call, so the refusal is live once that checkout carries the merge — no daemon restart; the architect raises the checkout update after merge. Pre-merge, the tester and implementer run the workspace entry: `cd -- "$LEGION_WORKSPACE" && bun packages/daemon/src/cli/index.ts gh -- …`.
